part3_worldInteractions.helpBindsText: Xbox: LS: up/down moves forward/backward, left/right steers the wolf; camera follows behind. RS: look around and tilt. RT runs, LT enters stealth; RT then LT sprints for 1.5 seconds; LT then RT enters super stealth. Release both to choose a new combination. Hold LB to focus the nearest object close enough ahead (it glows); moving forward then steers toward it. Hold RB and keep a prey inside the aim cone to lock it; X then steers the leap onto that lock. X jump, A interact, D-pad ↑ hour, hold D-pad ← to rewind the dial, hold D-pad → to go forward, LS click pause or play, — menu, B close this panel. Keyboard: WASD: up/down moves forward/backward, left/right steers the wolf; camera follows behind. Arrows: look around and tilt. Shift runs, C enters stealth; Shift then C sprints for 1.5 seconds; C then Shift enters super stealth. Release both to choose a new combination. Hold F to focus the nearest object close enough ahead (it glows); moving forward then steers toward it. Hold Q and keep a prey inside the aim cone to lock it; Space then steers the leap onto that lock. Space jump, E interact, T hour, hold , to rewind the dial, hold . to go forward, ; pause or play, Esc menu, P photo mode (free camera, rewind, capture). Rebind any of these under Esc → Controls.
